name: Harkus Grishenko
summary: A revenant guard of the Order of the Silver Dragon who warned the party of Hornguard's order.

facts.text: A revenant guard of the Order who found the party as they woke and warned that Commander Hornguard would order his knights to destroy them.
Urged the party to return Argynvost's skull to the cemetery before Hornguard's wrath fell, and apologized for the harm he might be made to do them.

name: Vladimir Hornguard
summary: Commander of the Order of the Silver Dragon at Argynvostholt.

facts.text: Called every knight of the Order back to Argynvostholt by noon, enraged that the party broke into Castle Ravenloft.
Waited in the cemetery mausoleum, but Zora's distraction let Aera mount the skull before any fight.
Took Argynvost's hand after Shabasta's words and crumbled to ash when the dragon told him his watch had ended.

name: Argynvost
summary: The silver dragon who led the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: Rose as a ghostly silver dragon when his skull was set on its mount in the mausoleum.
Freed his knights, blessed Olfin's longsword and asked the party to bear the Order's legacy.
Burned his spirit into a silver beacon in Argynvostholt's tallest tower, lasting perhaps about seven days.

name: Argynvostholt
summary: The ruined manor of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: About three hours from Krezk by way of the Raven River crossroads.
Its revenants dissolved into mist once Argynvost's skull rested in the cemetery mausoleum.
Its tallest tower now holds the silver beacon of Argynvost's spirit.

name: Sir Godfried William
summary: A knight of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: Freed from his revenant body and restored to the golden-haired knight he was, with blue eyes.
Told the party of Kasimir Velikov's visit and of the Amber Temple near the peak of Mount Ghakis.
Its knights were freed when Vladimir Hornguard accepted his rest.
The party swore the Order's oath and now carry its legacy.
Flew into the mausoleum and harried Vladimir Hornguard's face so Aera could mount the skull without a fight.

name: Aera shan Ravanór
summary: A party member and skilled archer.

facts.text: Was frozen rigid by the wire-bound revenant's glare in the foyer of Argynvostholt.
Climbed the mausoleum wall and set Argynvost's skull on its mount in one clean climb.
Argynvost warned her to beware how fiercely she gazes into the amber shard she carries.
Opened a door through the air to carry himself and Aera into the cemetery mausoleum.
His words persuaded Vladimir Hornguard to take Argynvost's hand and accept his rest.
Took the wire-bound revenant's head off with a bolt of fire in the foyer of Argynvostholt.
Held the wire-bound revenant in place in the foyer of Argynvostholt.
Argynvost blessed his longsword with silver flame.

name: Malron Lichtstrahl
summary: A party member and cleric of Lathander.

facts.text: Gave last rites to a vampire's victim on the road from Krezk to Argynvostholt.
Blessed by Argynvost: a +1 magic weapon with 3 charges, all regained at dawn.
Kasimir Velikov, a dusk elf, came to Argynvostholt weeks earlier seeking the Amber Temple's history, location and contents, and may be able to guide the party there.

name: Amber Temple
summary: A temple where the Sunsword may be hidden.

facts.text: Lies near the peak of Mount Ghakis, at the end of a long-lost trail, according to Sir Godfried.
Was seen alone on the rooftops of Castle Ravenloft, her face lit with hope, when Argynvost's beacon flared.

name: Kaven the Blood Drinker
summary: A figure of the first folk.

facts.text: His spirit lifted its head at his lonely cairn when Argynvost's beacon flared.
Was seen in tears on the doorstep of her manor when Argynvost's beacon flared.
Set on its mount in the Argynvostholt cemetery mausoleum by Aera, restoring Argynvost's spirit.
